info.name: TetraScience Data and AI Cloud Access Groups Search API
Search files via Elasticsearch Query Language

items.docs: Execute advanced search queries using Elasticsearch Query Language to find files based on metadata, content, labels, and processing attributes. Use this for complex search operations that require precise filtering.

params.name: category
params.description: File category. Values are RAW, IDS, and PROCESSED.

params.name: from
params.description: Display files started from a specified number in the results array. By default, files are displayed from the start of the array (the number 0). This parameter is included if the result set is large, pagination might be required. This parameter is typically used in conjunction with size.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Search for files created on or after a specific date.

params.name: excludeTags
params.description: Lists the tags that should be excluded. Files that have the specified tags associated with them do not appear in search results.

params.name: ids
params.description: Name, type, and version of the schema used to create the IDS file.  Format is {namespace}/{idsType}:{idsVersion}.

params.name: integrationType
params.description: Integration type.  Values are EGNYTE, BOX, DOTMATICS, HRB CELLARIO, DATAHUB, PIPELINE, RAW, and API.

params.name: metadata.[key]
params.description: Searches for files that have specific metadata.

params.name: rawFileId
params.description: UUID for the RAW file that this file was generated from.

params.name: size
params.description: Indicates the number of results to return in the request.  This parameter is included if the result set is large, pagination might be required.   This parameter is typically used in conjunction with from.

params.name: sort
params.description: Indicates the sort order for the search results.  Sort occurs on the date (createAt timestamp, which occurred when the file was created in the data lake. Options: desc, asc

params.name: sourceType
params.description: Type of source, which is typically the name of the instrument or other lab equipment used to generate the data or report.

params.name: traceId
params.description: UUID generated when the RAW file is first uploaded to the data lake. All files derived from the RAW file, such as an IDS file, have the same traceId.

params.name: tags
params.description: Lists tags that the user added to the file.

params.name: toDate
params.description: Search for files created on or before a specific date.

items.docs: 🚧 IMPORTANT The Search Files (GET) endpoint is on a deprecation path and does not support searching for files by metadata.
